newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill to get most of BIG bank GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Merrill to get most of BIG bank GDRs.

text.p: Polish bank BIG SA said it had signed a deal under which Merrill Lynch will buy 60 percent of the bank's three million global depositary receipts (GDR), which represent 45 million shares of its 65-million issue.

The bank, whose full names Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA, said in a statement that the accord, signed in London on Monday, also provided for selling 20 percent of the GDRs to Dresdner Kleinwort Benson Limited and a total of five percent to Credit Lyonnais, Daiwa Europe, NatWest Securities and Salomon Brothers.
BIG's new issue, priced at 3.4 zloty a share, is to help refinance the acquisition of Bank Gdanski. Each GDR represent 15 shares.

BIG's statement also said that the buyers of the bank's GDRs had underwritten 17,058,824 shares from its 20-million-share domestic tranche. The remainder has been underwritten by Bank Handlowy and Creditanstalt Securities, it said.
"As a result the whole issue, series I, amounting to 65 million shares have been underwritten," the statement said.
The underwriters' fee is 3.75 percent of the revenues from the GDR sale, it said.
It said that Bank Gdanski, in which BIG has 63.4 percent, has granted Merrill Lynch a 30-day option to buy eight million of BIG shares held by Gdanski. The shares will be bought in the form of GDRs.
Type of issue: new common shares
Lead Domestic Manager: BIG-BG sp zoo.
Use Of Proceeds: refinance acquisition of
NOTES: Bank of New York is depository bank for GDRs and Bank Pekao SA is the custodian bank.
